items.title: Tata Group's Agratas Sees Chinese Partner's Board Nominee Exit Ahead of Key Launch
items.snippet: Tata Group’s battery joint venture Agratas has lost its board representative from Chinese technical partner AESC Apollo ahead of its commercial rollout. The move comes as Agratas develops its own battery production capabilities and is preparing to scale in India and the UK.

items.title: Disney Orders Managers to Find 20% Savings Amid Plans for Thousands of Job Cuts
items.snippet: Disney is said to be readying thousands of job losses in a massive reorganisation and cost-saving effort. The entertainment behemoth has instructed some managers to look for methods to cut annual operational costs by 20%, although it’s unknown how many jobs would be lost.
